meta_title: P Johnson Decorators | Painter & Decorator Leeds
meta_description: P Johnson Decorators in Leeds offers professional interior and exterior painting, decorating, and wallpapering. Free quotes. Local family business since 2001.
hero_subhead: Interior and exterior painting done right. Free estimates, no mess, and we always finish on time.
services_subhead: From feature walls and wallpapering to full exterior repaints, we handle every job with care and precision.

services.title: Interior Painting
services.desc: Professional wall and ceiling painting using premium paints. We prep thoroughly, protect your furniture, and leave zero mess behind.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior finishes for fascias, soffits, doors, and render. Built to last 5–7 years in the Yorkshire climate.

services.title: Wallpapering
services.desc: Expert hanging of feature walls and full room papering. We source, match patterns, and fit cleanly every time.

services.title: Woodwork & Trim
services.desc: Skirting boards, doors, windows, and shutters painted to a flawless finish. We sand, prime, and apply multiple coats for durability.

services.title: Artexing & Textured Finishes
services.desc: Create or repair textured ceilings and walls. Ideal for hiding imperfections and adding character to dated rooms.

services.title: Specialist Coatings
services.desc: Floorboards, MDF, kitchen cupboards, and bathroom tiles painted with specialist finishes designed to resist moisture and wear.

about_pullquote: We turn tired rooms into spaces you'll love living in, every single time.
about_para_1: P Johnson Decorators has been transforming homes across Leeds and Bramley since 2001. Paul and the team specialise in both residential and commercial projects, from single-room refreshes to full house redecorations. Over two decades, we've built a reputation for reliable timekeeping, honest pricing, and work that stands the test of time.
about_para_2: What sets us apart is our attention to detail and respect for your home. We protect your belongings, tidy up each day, and always explain what we're doing and why. Our repeat customer rate speaks for itself — many families have had us back three, four, or five times. If you're not happy with the finish, we'll put it right.
reviews_heading: What Leeds Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had Paul and his team in to repaint the whole downstairs. They were tidy, professional, and finished bang on schedule. The quality of the finish is brilliant — you'd think it was done by a shop. Will definitely use them again.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Needed the kitchen cupboards painted and was worried about disruption. Paul organised everything brilliantly — we could still use the kitchen, no fuss. The cupboards look brand new. Honestly couldn't fault them.
reviews.author: Sandra K.

reviews.text: Exterior of the house needed doing — timber, render, the lot. Very fair price and Paul explained exactly what was happening. Done in good time, high-quality finish, and they left the place spotless. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David L.
